# Draft:King Fahd History Exhibition – Spirit of Leadership

}}
King Fahd History Exhibition – Spirit of Leadership is a traveling historical and cultural exhibition documenting the life and legacy of King Fahd bin Abdulaziz Al Saud, former King of Saudi Arabia. The exhibition presents key milestones of his life and reign through archival documents, photographs, historical artifacts, and interactive multimedia displays. It was first launched in 2015 and has been held in several cities within Saudi Arabia and abroad.
Establishment
The first edition of the exhibition was inaugurated in Riyadh in 2015 as a documentation initiative aimed at presenting a comprehensive historical narrative of King Fahd bin Abdulaziz Al Saud and highlighting his role in Saudi Arabia’s development and modernization during his reign.
Nature of the exhibition
The exhibition is classified as a traveling exhibition, having been hosted in multiple cities to allow wider public access to its historical content and educational objectives.
Organisation
The exhibition was organized by the sons and grandchildren of King Fahd bin Abdulaziz Al Saud, in cooperation with official cultural and historical institutions, most notably the King Abdulaziz Foundation for Research and Archives (Darah), which supervised the historical content, archival materials, and overall documentation process.
Executive committee
According to the official exhibition website, the executive committee overseeing the exhibition included the following members:
* Prince Turki bin Mohammed bin Fahd bin Abdulaziz — Chairman of the Executive Committee.
* Prince Abdulaziz bin Saud bin Fahd bin Abdulaziz — Vice Chairman of the Executive Committee.
* Prince Abdulaziz bin Mohammed bin Fahd bin Abdulaziz — Member of the Executive Committee.
Exhibition content
The exhibition features a wide range of historical materials, including official documents, archival photographs, historical artifacts, audiovisual materials, and interactive displays that reflect different stages of King Fahd’s life and the political, social, and developmental transformations experienced by Saudi Arabia during his reign.
Tours and locations
The exhibition has been held in several locations, including:
* Riyadh (2015)
* Jeddah (2015)
* Dhahran (2016)
* Kuwait City (2019)
Objectives
The exhibition aims to:
* Document the life and legacy of King Fahd bin Abdulaziz Al Saud.
* Highlight the developmental transformations of Saudi Arabia during his reign.
* Promote public awareness of Saudi national history.
* Present historical content using modern and interactive exhibition methods.
* Contribute to preserving national historical memory for future generations.
